alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Estado Salud Servicios-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando existen incidentes o avisos sobre los servicios de la plataforma Azure (Service Health).
alerts.detail: Tipo: Service Health (Activity Log) · Ámbito: Suscripción · Categorías: Service Issue / Planned Maintenance / Health Advisory / Security Advisory · Sev0–Sev3 · Evento: creación/actualización/cierre
alerts.technical_requirement: Suscripción con permisos de lectura sobre Service Health.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Estado Salud Recursos-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando un recurso cambia su estado de salud a Degraded o Unavailable (Resource Health).
alerts.detail: Tipo: Resource Health · Categoría: ResourceHealth · Estado previo: Available · Estado actual: Degraded / Unavailable · Reason Type: Unplanned/PlatformInitiated
alerts.technical_requirement: Recursos provisionados en la suscripción.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Asignacion Rol Suscripcion-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando una cuenta con privilegios asigna un rol RBAC en la suscripción de Azure.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Activity Log · Categoría: Administrative · Operación: Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write · Estado: Succeeded · Ámbito: Suscripción · Frecuencia: 5 min · Filtros: RoleDefinitionName, PrincipalType, Caller
alerts.kql_code:
// Asignación de rol en suscripción (Activity Log)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, Resource, Properties
alerts.technical_requirement: Suscripción con diagnostic settings enviando Activity Log al workspace (para KQL).

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Eliminacion Asignacion Rol-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando se elimina una asignación de rol RBAC en la suscripción.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Activity Log · Operación: Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/delete · Estado: Succeeded · Frecuencia: 5 min
alerts.technical_requirement: Activity Log habilitado a nivel de suscripción.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Modificacion Regla NSG-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando se crea, modifica o elimina una regla de un Network Security Group (NSG).
alerts.detail: Tipo: Activity Log · Categoría: Administrative · Operaciones: Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write y /delete; Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/write y /delete · Estado: Succeeded · Ámbito: Suscripción
alerts.kql_code:
// Modificación de reglas de NSG (Activity Log)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue in (
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/delete")
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, Resource, OperationNameValue
alerts.technical_requirement: NSG provisionados en la suscripción.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Creacion Recursos-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando se crean o despliegan nuevos recursos en la plataforma Azure.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Activity Log · Operaciones: */write y Microsoft.Resources/deployments/* · Estado: Succeeded · Ámbito: Suscripción · Frecuencia: 5 min
alerts.kql_code:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/WRITE"
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Success"
| where Caller contains "@"
| where ActivitySubstatusValue == "Created"
| where OperationNameValue !has "ROLEASSIGNMENTS"
| extend CreatedResourceId = coalesce(tostring(ResourceId), tostring(_ResourceId))
| where isnotempty(CreatedResourceId)
| extend ResourceIdParts = split(CreatedResourceId, "/")
| extend CreatedResourceName = tostring(ResourceIdParts[array_length(ResourceIdParts)-1])
| extend CreatedResourceType = replace_string(tostring(OperationNameValue), "/write", "")
| where not(OperationNameValue has "STORAGEACCOUNTS" and CreatedResourceName =~ "default")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by CreatedResourceId, CreatedResourceType, ResourceGroup
| project
    FechaCreacion = TimeGenerated,
    RecursoCreado = CreatedResourceName,
    TipoRecurso = CreatedResourceType,
    ResourceGroup,
    UsuarioEjecutor = Caller,
    IPOrigen = CallerIpAddress,
    Estado = ActivityStatusValue,
    SubEstado = ActivitySubstatusValue,
    ResourceId = CreatedResourceId,
    CorrelationId
| order by FechaCreacion desc
alerts.technical_requirement: Activity Log habilitado y enviado a Log Analytics.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Eliminacion Recursos-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando se eliminan recursos o despliegues en la plataforma Azure.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Activity Log · Categoría: Administrative · Operación: */delete · Estado: Succeeded · Ámbito: Suscripción · Frecuencia: 5 min
alerts.kql_code:
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/DELETE"
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Success"
| where Caller contains "@"
| extend DeletedResourceId = coalesce(tostring(ResourceId), tostring(_ResourceId))
| where isnotempty(DeletedResourceId)
| extend ResourceIdParts = split(DeletedResourceId, "/")
| extend DeletedResourceName = tostring(ResourceIdParts[array_length(ResourceIdParts)-1])
| extend DeletedResourceType = replace_string(tostring(OperationNameValue), "/delete", "")
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeletedResourceId, DeletedResourceType
| project
    FechaEliminacion = TimeGenerated,
    RecursoEliminado = DeletedResourceName,
    TipoRecurso = DeletedResourceType,
    ResourceGroup,
    UsuarioEjecutor = Caller,
    IPOrigen = CallerIpAddress,
    Estado = ActivityStatusValue,
    SubEstado = ActivitySubstatusValue,
    ResourceId = DeletedResourceId,
    CorrelationId
| order by FechaEliminacion desc
alerts.technical_requirement: Activity Log habilitado a nivel de suscripción.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta CPU VM Umbral 90-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el uso de CPU de la VM supera el 90% durante 15 minutos.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Métrica · Recurso: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines · Señal: Percentage CPU · Agregación: Avg · Condición: ≥90% · Ventana: 5 min · Evaluación cada: 5 min · 3 evaluaciones
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con métricas de plataforma habilitadas (no requiere agente).

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta CPU VM Umbral 95-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta crítica cuando el uso de CPU de la VM supera el 95%.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Métrica · Señal: Percentage CPU · Agregación: Avg · Condición: ≥95% · Ventana: 5 min · 3 evaluaciones
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta CPU VM > 90% (vía Log Analytics si se requiere KQL)
Perf
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| where InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize avg_cpu = avg(CounterValue) by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where avg_cpu >= 90
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con métricas de plataforma habilitadas.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Memoria RAM Umbral 90-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando la memoria RAM en uso de la VM supera el 90%.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: Perf · Contador: Memory \ % Committed Bytes In Use · Agregación: arg_max por Computer · Umbral: >90% · Ventana: 5 min
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta RAM > 90% (umbral parametrizable)
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, use_memory_percent = CounterValue
| where use_memory_percent > 90
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con Azure Monitor Agent (AMA) + DCR de Performance Counters. Costo asociado a Log Analytics.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Memoria RAM Umbral 95-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta crítica cuando la memoria RAM en uso supera el 95%.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: Perf · Contador: Memory \ % Committed Bytes In Use · Umbral: >95% · Ventana: 5 min · 3 evaluaciones
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta RAM crítica > 95%
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, use_memory_percent = CounterValue
| where use_memory_percent > 95
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con AMA + DCR habilitado.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Memoria Disponible <1GB-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando la memoria disponible en bytes es inferior a 1 GB.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Métrica · Señal: Available Memory Bytes · Agregación: Avg · Condición: <1073741824 (1 GB) · Ventana: 5 min · 3 evaluaciones
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con métricas guest habilitadas (AMA) para Available Memory Bytes.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Espacio Disco Umbral 20-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta preventiva cuando el espacio libre en disco es ≤20%.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: Perf · Contador: LogicalDisk \ % Free Space · Agregación por disco · Umbral: ≤20% · Ventana: 5 min
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta Espacio en Disco <= 20% libre
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Free Space"
| where InstanceName != "_Total"
| where InstanceName != "total"
| summarize FreeSpaceMin = min(CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FreeSpaceMin <= 20
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con AMA + DCR de Performance Counters.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Espacio Disco Critico Umbral 10-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta crítica cuando el espacio libre en disco es ≤10%.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: Perf · Contador: LogicalDisk \ % Free Space · Umbral: ≤10% · Ventana: 5 min · 3 evaluaciones
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta Espacio en Disco crítico <= 10% libre
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Free Space"
| where InstanceName != "_Total" and InstanceName != "total"
| summarize free_space = min(CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName
| where free_space <= 10
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con AMA + DCR habilitado. Costo asociado a Log Analytics.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Fallo Encendido VM-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando falla la operación de inicio (Start) de una máquina virtual.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Activity Log · Operación: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action · Estado: Failed · Ámbito: Suscripción
alerts.kql_code:
// Fallo de encendido de VM (Activity Log vía AzureActivity)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Failed"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceGroup, Resource, ActivityStatusValue, Properties
alerts.technical_requirement: Activity Log habilitado a nivel de suscripción.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta VM Heartbeat Perdido-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando una VM deja de enviar Heartbeat al workspace por más de 10 minutos (posible apagado / desconexión).
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: Heartbeat · Condición: LastHeartbeat < ago(10m) · Ventana: 15 min · Frecuencia: 5 min
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta VM sin Heartbeat (posible apagada/desconectada)
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(10m)
alerts.technical_requirement: VM con AMA conectada al workspace de Log Analytics.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta VM Availability-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando la disponibilidad de la VM (VM Availability Metric) cae por debajo de 1.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Métrica · Recurso: VM · Señal: VmAvailabilityMetric · Condición: <1 · Ventana: 5 min
alerts.technical_requirement: Métrica VM Availability disponible en Azure Monitor.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta ASR Replication Health Critical-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando la salud de replicación de un servidor protegido por Azure Site Recovery cambia a Critical.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: AzureDiagnostics · Categoría: AzureSiteRecoveryEvents · Filtro: description_s contiene 'Replication health changed to Critical' · Ventana: 1 h
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta ASR - Site Recovery Replication Health Critical
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureSiteRecoveryEvents"
| where description_s contains "Replication health changed to Critical."
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| project
    Hora_de_alerta = TimeGenerated,
    Servidor       = affectedResourceName_s,
    VaultName      = Resource,
    Description_s  = healthErrors_s,
    Severity       = Level
alerts.technical_requirement: Recovery Services Vault con diagnostic settings enviando AzureSiteRecoveryEvents al workspace.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta ASR Replication Health (Horario Comercial)-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta ASR Replication Health con discriminación de horario para evitar ruido fuera de horario comercial / ventana de mantenimiento.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: AzureDiagnostics · Categoría: AzureSiteRecoveryEvents · Filtro: hourofday entre rango definido · Ventana: 30 d (revisión histórica) o 1h (operativa)
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta ASR con discriminación de horario (fuera de ventana de mantenimiento)
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureSiteRecoveryEvents"
| where description_s contains "Replication health changed to Critical."
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where hourofday(TimeGenerated) >= 14 and hourofday(TimeGenerated) < 2
| project
    Hora_de_alerta = TimeGenerated,
    Servidor       = affectedResourceName_s,
    Nombre_Vault   = Resource,
    Descripcion    = healthErrors_s,
    Severity       = Level
alerts.technical_requirement: Recovery Services Vault con diagnostic settings habilitados.

alerts.name: BIT-CLIENTE-Alerta Backup Job Failed-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando un job de Azure Backup termina en estado Failed.
alerts.detail: Tipo: Log Alert · Tabla: AzureDiagnostics · Categoría: AddonAzureBackupJobs · Filtros: JobOperation_s = Backup, JobStatus_s = Failed · Ventana: 24 h
alerts.kql_code:
// Alerta Azure Backup - Jobs fallidos
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category contains "AddonAzureBackupJobs"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where JobOperation_s =~ "Backup"
| where JobStatus_s =~ "Failed"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    BackupItemFriendlyName_s,
    JobOperation_s,
    JobStatus_s,
    JobFailureCode_s,
    Resource
alerts.technical_requirement: Recovery Services Vault con diagnostic settings enviando AddonAzureBackupJobs al workspace.

alerts.name: BIT-MON-BUDGET-NOMBRE SUSCRIPCION
alerts.description: Alerta cuando el gasto (actual o forecast) supera el 95% del presupuesto definido en la suscripción.

kql.name: ASR Replication Health Critical
kql.description: Detecta cambio de salud de replicación a Critical en ASR
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta ASR - Site Recovery Replication Health Critical
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureSiteRecoveryEvents"
| where description_s contains "Replication health changed to Critical."
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(1h)
| project
    Hora_de_alerta = TimeGenerated,
    Servidor       = affectedResourceName_s,
    VaultName      = Resource,
    Description_s  = healthErrors_s,
    Severity       = Level

kql.name: ASR con discriminación de horario
kql.description: Filtra alertas ASR por rango horario operativo
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta ASR con discriminación de horario (fuera de ventana de mantenimiento)
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category == "AzureSiteRecoveryEvents"
| where description_s contains "Replication health changed to Critical."
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(30d)
| where hourofday(TimeGenerated) >= 14 and hourofday(TimeGenerated) < 2
| project
    Hora_de_alerta = TimeGenerated,
    Servidor       = affectedResourceName_s,
    Nombre_Vault   = Resource,
    Descripcion    = healthErrors_s,
    Severity       = Level

kql.name: Backup Job Failed
kql.description: Jobs de Azure Backup que terminaron en Failed en últimas 24h
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta Azure Backup - Jobs fallidos
AzureDiagnostics
| where Category contains "AddonAzureBackupJobs"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| where JobOperation_s =~ "Backup"
| where JobStatus_s =~ "Failed"
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    BackupItemFriendlyName_s,
    JobOperation_s,
    JobStatus_s,
    JobFailureCode_s,
    Resource

kql.name: Memoria RAM > 90%
kql.description: % Committed Bytes In Use mayor a 90% por máquina
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta RAM > 90% (umbral parametrizable)
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, use_memory_percent = CounterValue
| where use_memory_percent > 90

kql.name: Memoria RAM > 95% (crítico)
kql.description: % Committed Bytes In Use mayor a 95% por máquina
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta RAM crítica > 95%
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Committed Bytes In Use"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, CounterValue) by Computer
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, use_memory_percent = CounterValue
| where use_memory_percent > 95

kql.name: Disco <= 20% libre
kql.description: % Free Space menor o igual a 20% por disco lógico
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta Espacio en Disco <= 20% libre
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Free Space"
| where InstanceName != "_Total"
| where InstanceName != "total"
| summarize FreeSpaceMin = min(CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where FreeSpaceMin <= 20

kql.name: Disco <= 10% libre (crítico)
kql.description: % Free Space menor o igual a 10% por disco lógico
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta Espacio en Disco crítico <= 10% libre
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Free Space"
| where InstanceName != "_Total" and InstanceName != "total"
| summarize free_space = min(CounterValue) by Computer, InstanceName
| where free_space <= 10

kql.name: CPU VM > 90%
kql.description: Procesador % en Log Analytics (alternativa a métrica)
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta CPU VM > 90% (vía Log Analytics si se requiere KQL)
Perf
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| where InstanceName == "_Total"
| summarize avg_cpu = avg(CounterValue) by Computer, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where avg_cpu >= 90

kql.name: VM sin Heartbeat
kql.description: VM sin reportar Heartbeat por más de 10 min
kql.kql_query:
// Alerta VM sin Heartbeat (posible apagada/desconectada)
Heartbeat
| summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
| where LastHeartbeat < ago(10m)

kql.name: Fallo de encendido de VM
kql.description: Operación Start de VM con estado Failed
kql.kql_query:
// Fallo de encendido de VM (Activity Log vía AzureActivity)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start/action"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Failed"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, ResourceGroup, Resource, ActivityStatusValue, Properties

kql.name: Modificación de regla NSG
kql.description: Cambios en NSG y sus securityRules
kql.kql_query:
// Modificación de reglas de NSG (Activity Log)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue in (
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/securityRules/delete",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/write",
    "Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups/delete")
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, Resource, OperationNameValue

kql.name: Asignación de rol en suscripción
kql.kql_query:
// Asignación de rol en suscripción (Activity Log)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue =~ "Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, Resource, Properties

kql.name: Eliminación de recursos
kql.kql_query:
// Eliminación de recursos (Activity Log)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/delete"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| where CategoryValue == "Administrative"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, Resource, OperationNameValue

kql.name: Creación de recursos
kql.kql_query:
// Creación de recursos (Activity Log)
AzureActivity
| where OperationNameValue endswith "/write"
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ "Succeeded"
| where CategoryValue == "Administrative"
| project TimeGenerated, Caller, CallerIpAddress, ResourceGroup, Resource, OperationNameValue
